Page.Title: FileOps Workspace
Page.Subtitle: Emergency file operations for containerized or otherwise restricted runtimes, backed by .NET cross-platform file APIs.

Workspace.PathInput: Absolute path inside the allowed roots
Workspace.PathHelper: You can paste a full path. The module still enforces allowed roots and read-only segments.
Workspace.EmptyDirectory: This directory does not contain any visible entries.
Workspace.NoSelectionSubtitle: Browse from the left workspace and open a text file for preview or editing.
Workspace.DirectorySelectionSubtitle: Open the directory to continue browsing or upload/create content inside it.
Workspace.EditorSubtitle: Only configured text extensions can be edited. Binary files stay download-only.
Workspace.UploadHelper: Single-file uploads keep the workflow predictable in restricted environments.
Workspace.TruncatedEntries: Only the first {0} entries are shown for this directory.
Workspace.ReadOnlyDirectory: The current directory is read-only under the active runtime policy.
Workspace.DropZoneHint: The upload obeys the active max upload size and allowed root policy.

RuntimeConfigDialog.Title: FileOps Runtime Configuration
RuntimeConfigDialog.Intro: Keep the scope narrow. This module is designed for emergency access in constrained runtimes, not as a general-purpose file manager.
RuntimeConfigDialog.AllowedRootsHelper: One path per line. Only these roots and their descendants are reachable.
RuntimeConfigDialog.ReadOnlyPathsHelper: One path per line. Writes, uploads, edits, and deletes are blocked under these paths.
RuntimeConfigDialog.StartupPathHelper: Initial location when the page opens. It falls back to the first allowed root when invalid.
RuntimeConfigDialog.EditableExtensionsHelper: Comma, semicolon, or newline separated. Only these extensions can be edited in the built-in editor.

CreateDirectoryDialog.Title: Create directory
CreateDirectoryDialog.DirectoryNameHelper: Use a single directory name. Path separators are not allowed.

DeleteDialog.Title: Delete entry
DeleteDialog.DirectoryWarning: Directory deletion may remove nested files that are currently the fastest way to inspect production issues. Use it carefully.

BatchDeleteDialog.Title: Delete selected entries
BatchDeleteDialog.DirectoryWarning: {0} selected directories will be deleted recursively when this option is enabled.
